description: Viet Nam Disaster and Dyke Management Information System is a data repository run by Viet Nam Disaster and Dyke Management Authority. The system carries real-time disaster warnings, dyke and reservoir information, flood and storm bulletins and disaster loss reports of the national disaster management authority. Coverage: Viet Nam. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as html; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("Thông báo chuyển đổi tên miền - Cục Quản lý đê điều và Phòng, chống thiên tai") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. The page read on 2026-09-30 announced a domain name change. It can support flood and dyke studies in Viet Nam. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
